burro exec · run a command or local script in the project folder on the server

Usage: burro exec [--max-lines 60] [--] cmd args…
       burro exec --file path [args…]

  --max-lines n    lines to show, the rest stays on the server (default 60)
  --file path      local script to run, with its shebang or bash

Example
  burro exec -- ls -la

Exit codes  0 command passed · 1 command failed · 2 server problem
            4 bad flags or burro.toml
